title: 5 Signs You Are Being "Quiet Fired" & How To Protect Yourself
description:
CHECK OUT MY BOOK: https://emilydurham.org/clock-in

Is your boss secretly trying to push you out? 
Quiet firing is when they don’t fire you outright… but slowly make your job so miserable or pointless that you eventually quit. It’s sneaky, it’s toxic, and it might already be happening to you without you realizing it.
In this video, I’m breaking down 5 red flags your boss is "quiet firing" you so you can spot the signs early and protect your career. If you’ve been feeling ignored, sidelined, or like your confidence at work is slowly being chipped away, this is for you.
We’ll talk about:

Subtle ways your boss distances themselves from you
How your workload, projects, and schedule can signal you’re being pushed out
What it means when opportunities suddenly disappear
The emotional toll of quiet firing (and how to separate your worth from your job)
What you can actually do next if these signs feel a little too familiar

You deserve a workplace that respects you, not one that slowly phases you out. Consider this your internet big sister intervention. 


 If this hit a little too close to home, you are NOT alone.
Save this video to come back to later, and send it to a friend who’s dealing with a toxic boss.
